current_date: Document text dated March 2018; council page says final version published January 2019, reviewed 11 January 2021 with no changes
current_evidence: The council's 'National and local requirements for planning applications' page (updated 05/01/2026) links only file 6017. It says the list was published January 2019 and reviewed in January 2021. A web search found no newer list.

issues.detail: Grokbot marked Householder '(none)', yet section 2 is a dedicated householder local list: 2a site/block plan (all householder); 2b existing and proposed floor plans; 2c elevations; 2d detailed drawings for roof extensions, roof terraces, dormers and window/door replacement; 2e parking plan (all); 2f hardstanding details (where hard standing is laid). Grokbot even captured the heading 'Local requirements - Plans and drawings for householder applications' in tab_items.
issues.evidence: Section 2 'Local requirements - Plans and drawings for householder applications'

issues.detail: Grokbot omitted these local requirements: 3g parking plan (increase or reduction in on-site parking); 3h floor space/accommodation schedule (major); 3i bin stores/recycling (new development needing bin storage); 3j hardstanding; 4a retail shop fronts; 4b plant, flues, ventilation or air conditioning at retail/business premises; 5b street scene (all new-build residential); 5c/6c character analysis and appraisal (new-build residential; non-residential new buildings); 5d/6a/7c samples of materials; 7b photographs (demolition in a CA or of a listed building); 7e statement of justification (substantial harm or total loss of a listed building); 8g light impact assessment; 8h noise impact assessment; 8i planning statement (all major); 8m site waste management plan (residential, major, A3-A5); 8o sequential test (main town centre uses outside centre); 4c-4i application-specific drawings for adverts, NMA, LBC, LDCs, s73 and outline. As a result Advertisement consent, Lawful development cert, s73, NMA and Outline show '(none)' wrongly.

Affordable Housing: the trigger is cut off and drops the rural threshold of '11 or more dwellings in rural areas'. Statement of Community Involvement: the excerpt is heading text, but the source applies it only to wind installations of more than two turbines or hub height over 15 m. Structural Survey: the excerpt is heading text, but the source says conversion of rural buildings, or listed buildings where works involve demolition or affect structural integrity. Archaeological, Biodiversity and Ecology excerpts are scrambled table headers ('Types of application and when required What is required Policy driver...'). Highways includes national-list text ('Page 2 of 33 No National re').
issues.evidence: 5a: '15 dwellings or more within the urban areas ... 11 or more dwellings in rural areas'; 8j wind turbine thresholds

issues.detail: Schedule of works (listed building) is under Full planning, and its trigger is tree/landscaping text. The source (7f) applies it to structural alteration or demolition of a listed building, i.e. LBC. Roof plan sits under Advertisement consent, but 3e applies it to alterations to the roof layout. Across the board, Grokbot labelled about 25 items 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'. Section 8 says they apply to 'all types of development' by trigger (e.g. Flood risk assessment, Contaminated land, Tree survey).
issues.evidence: Section 8 heading 'Reports and assessments (all types of development)'; 7f Schedule of works

issues.detail: 'Employment / Economic Statement' is not a local-list item: its excerpt is policy-reference text, and the source's equivalent is 8t Marketing information, which Grokbot already lists separately. The Design and Access Statement excerpt ('You can provide this information in the design and access statement, where one is required') is guidance text, and the DAS is national. Environmental Statement is statutory.
issues.evidence: 8t Marketing information: loss of B1/B2/B8 employment sites

issues.detail: Transport Assessment and Travel Plan are split into two rows with the same trigger, though the source has one combined item (8l/8m heading). The Drawing standards tab repeats the site/block plan and 'proportionate plans' text for householder and non-householder.
issues.evidence: '8l 8m Transport statement or transport assessment and travel plan'

summary: The link works and is still the council's only published list, but that list dates from 2018/2019, was last reviewed in January 2021 and is past the council's own two-year validity. Grokbot missed the entire householder section and around 20 other numbered local requirements, and many triggers are scrambled table headers.

withdrawn_issues.detail: The current list is effectively out of date by the council's own rule. The page says the local list must be less than two years old, but the last review was 11 January 2021 (valid for 2 years, to about January 2023). The list still uses the old A3/A4/A5/B1 use classes and pre-BNG ecology requirements. The workbook should flag that this list is past its review date, not just 'Outdated'.
withdrawn_issues.evidence: Council page: reviewed 11 January 2021, 'valid for a further two years'
withdrawn_issues.grok_comment: The facts are right (the council page in raw 0a935c44e8 gives a review on 11 January 2021, "valid for a further two years"), but the workbook already flags the list Outdated=Yes, so no further flag change is needed.
withdrawn_issues.claude_response: Accepted. The workbook already flags the list as outdated.
